verses.text: Haxo yik ix nachajel yuj winhaj Balaam to scha sk'o'ol Jehová ayik syalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb' israel, majxo b'atlaj winh sk'anb'ej yab' icha ix yutej t'a sb'ab'elal, anhej to ix b'at k'elan winh t'a tzinan lu'um chi'.
Haxo ix yilanb'at chonhab' Israel winh, t'a stzolal yaj junjun inhtilal heb' yet' scampamento, ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winh,
yuj chi' ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik: Haton hin lolonel ha hin Balaam hin tik, yuninal hin winhaj Beor, jichichi tz'aj wilani.
Swab' tas syal Dios. Icha wayichal tz'aj wilan Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil. Tzin ek' jichan, palta jakan hin sat, te wach' wilani.
Hex israel yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob, te wach' yilji he mantiado. Te wach' kilanb'at he campamento.

Icha wal yaj stzolal te' palma, icha wal chi' heyiljib'ati. Icha wal sb'at tzololok junok tas tz'awchaj t'a sti' junok ha ha', icha wal chi' heyajemi. Icha te' áloes awab'il yuj Jehová, ma icha wal yaj te' k'ute' t'a sti' ha ha'.

Ha b'aj ayek' chonhab' Israel chi', manhxo jantakok ha ha'. Wach'nhej yuk'an ha' heb' yet' yak'anoch yalil tas syawej heb'. Ha sreyal heb' te ay smay t'a yichanh winhaj rey Agag. Te niwan yaj smakb'en sreyal heb'.

Ha Jehová ix ik'anelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ha Jehová ayoch yipok sk'o'ol heb', icha nok' owal wakax ha sch'a'ak ayoch yipok sk'o'ol. Ha chonhab' Israel ol satanel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ol smak'poj sb'akil heb' yajk'o'ol heb' chi'. Ol k'axpajek' sjul-lab' heb' t'a sniwanil heb' yajk'o'ol chi'.

Lajan wal heb' icha junok nok' choj jichanek' swayi, malaj mach stek'b'ej sb'a stzuntzani. Hex israel, alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a mach tz'alan wach' lolonel t'ayex, katab'ajokab' mach tzex katab'ani, xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh lolonel chi' winhaj Balac chi', ix te kot yowal winh sik'lab'il, ix smuch'an jun sk'ab' winh ix schuk'anoch winh t'a yol junxo sk'ab' yuj yowal chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha yuj ha katab'an heb' ajk'o'ol yajoch tik t'ayin ix hach wawtejkoti, haxo tikne'ik yoxelalxo halan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh heb'.

Te wach' hama tzach meltzaj t'a ha pat t'a elanhchamel. Toxo ix wala' to niwan tas ol wak' t'ayach, ol hach wik'ancha'anh, palta max schalaj sk'o'ol Jehová to icha chi' tz'aji, xchi winhaj Balac chi'.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj Balaam chi' icha tik: --Jichan ix aj walan t'a heb' ha chekab':

Wach'chom b'ut'an ha palacio yuj k'e'en oro, ma yuj k'e'en plata, tzak'an k'e'en t'ayin, palta max yal-laj hin k'exan tas syal Jehová, max yal-laj wak'an wach'k'olal, ma hin katab'an b'aj skot t'a hin k'o'ol hin k'ulani, yujto ha tas schek Jehová wala', haton yowalil swala'.
Wach' ol hin meltzaj t'a hin chonhab'. Anhej, ayik mantzak hin b'ati, swalkan t'ayach tas ol utaj ha chonhab' tik yuj jun chonhab'il anima chi' t'a b'ak'inh, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winh yalan icha tik: Haton hin lolonel ha hin Balaam hin tik, yuninal hin winhaj Beor, jichichi tz'aj wilani.

Swab' tas syal Dios Ek'to t'a yib'anh Smasanil, wojtak tas yaj spensar, swilanpax icha wayichal. Ha Dios Syal yuj Smasanil chi' tz'ak'an wojtakejeli. Tzin ek' jichan, palta jakan hin sat, te wach'nhej wilani.

Ay jun mach najatto ay, palta syal wilanb'ati. Ay jun rey ol cheklajk'e t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob, tzikiki yilji icha k'e'en k'anal. Ha jun rey chi' ol yak' yajalil t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Israel. Ha' ol satanel chonhab' Moab, ha pax ol satanel heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Set.
Ol kan chonhab' Edom t'a yalanh yuj, ol ochkan lum Seir chi' yikok. Ha chonhab' Israel ol yik' yip.
Ha t'a skal heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob ol elta jun mach ol och Yajalil. Ha' ol satanel jantakto mach ol kan t'a yol jun chonhab' chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yilanb'at chonhab' Amalec winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha chonhab' Amalec yelxo ay smay t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab', palta ol satel t'a jun'elnhej, xchi winh.
Ix b'at k'elan winh t'a schonhab' heb' quenita, ix yalan winh icha tik: Hex quenita, wach'chom te ay smay he chonhab' yik skolan sb'a, wach'chom t'a schontak k'e'en niwak tenam tzeyak'k'e he pat,
palta ol satkanel he chonhab' chi', ha jantak hexto ol hex kanok, ol hex yik'kanb'at heb' winh asirio schekab'ok, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winh icha tik: Ay, ¿tokwal ayto mach ol kanok ayik ol sk'ulan juntzanh tik Dios?
Ay te' barco ol kot t'a Chipre, ol ja t'a sti' ha' mar yik tzul yixtan chonhab' Asiria yet' chonhab' Heber, palta ol satjokpaxel heb' aj Chipre chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh tik winh, ix meltzaj winh t'a schonhab', haxo winhaj Balac ix meltzajxikan winh b'aj kajan.
